name: trajectory-cap
question: Does docs/PROJECT_TRAJECTORY.md exceed its documented size caps (total lines, total bytes, single-line length) or contain encoding-corruption (mojibake) -- the signature of a Phase 12 run that appended instead of reshaping?

assertion.asserts: docs/PROJECT_TRAJECTORY.md is within its documented size caps and free of encoding corruption -- i.e. Phase 12 reshaped the file rather than appending to it
assertion.measures: line count, byte count, longest single-line length, and a mojibake-signature line count of that one file, each against a configured threshold
known_gaps: near-identity by construction: the caps ARE line/byte/length counts, so P and Q barely differ. This declaration is deliberately boring -- a `valid` verdict under OVALID-04 is the correct outcome and not every oracle needs a gap

size within caps is not evidence of a good reshape: a Phase 12 run that truncated the file, or reshaped it into something useless, passes every threshold. This oracle bounds bloat, it does not judge content
single-file scope: it says nothing about any other doc that Phase 12 might have appended to

cost_provenance: measured 2026-06-12 on the ULDF framework repo under Git Bash (win32; slowest supported environment) -- pessimistic-honest per ORACLE-COST-01; under-declaration causes timeout kills

details.longest_line_chars: integer (length of the longest single line)
details.longest_line_number: integer (1-based line number of the longest line)
details.mojibake_lines: integer (count of lines containing UTF-8/CP1252 mojibake markers)
details.violations: string[] (human-readable cap breaches, empty when clean)

fallback: Open docs/PROJECT_TRAJECTORY.md and check: is it more than ~250 lines, more than ~32KB, or does any single line run to thousands of characters? If so, Phase 12 of /0-uldf-finalize appended instead of reshaping (it is supposed to prune to 5 capped sections). The fix is the Phase 12 REPAIR path: salvage the section headers + short bullet lines that still parse, discard the bloated spans, and rewrite a clean capped file (do NOT preserve-merge into the bloated one). The repaired file fully replaces the old. Re-run /0-uldf-finalize (or just reshape by hand to claude-template/templates/PROJECT_TRAJECTORY.md structure).

provenance.note: Starter Verification Oracle. Trigger incident DISC-TRAJ-01: Phase 12 (TRAJECTORY-02) is prose-only -- the size caps were agent-executed instructions with no deterministic enforcement, so runs that appended a multi-thousand-char 'Last updated' line and skipped pruning accumulated silently. Found bloated trajectories across nearly every instrumented project (SessionHelm 262KB / 57KB single line, quiqpic 277KB, GitCellar 198KB). A line-count check alone MISSES this (SessionHelm was 173 lines) -- the giant-single-line and byte-size signals are load-bearing. Advisory (status=warn, exit 0): the breach is self-correcting within the same /0-uldf-finalize via the Phase 12 REPAIR path, so this oracle must NOT block the commit that runs the repair.

config.comment: Caps mirror SPECIFICATION.md TRAJECTORY-01/02 (~250 lines / ~2k tokens). max_bytes (32KB ~= 8k tokens) is a defensive accumulation cap with generous headroom over the ~2k-token target; max_line_chars catches the giant-single-line append failure that a line-count check misses. Edit these constants in the run scripts to change scope; keep the <2s speed contract (ORACULURGY Part 11.3.3).
